answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond for a beacon post in the atlas. Each epoch the post emits an ember signal for two auditors, who each verify the atlas entry. Each auditor takes at most five posts per epoch, staking 30 credits per verdict. On disagreement a beacon recheck decides; a bad approval loses the stake. The first fake costs 35; the kth costs 35+5(k-1); the 1000th costs 5030; 1000 fakes cost 2,532,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-auditor ring fails: the cap forces many auditors, and bad approvals burn stake. Honest operators pay 35 once and recover the bond after one epoch.
